assumptions: Illustrative rates, not wage benchmarks, quoted agency prices or actual company costs.
Permanent capacity is available from the first day; no recruiting lead time or hiring cost.
Scheduled regular hours are paid even when absent or idle, including the fixed recovery window.
Overtime is paid only to present workers; no weekly, fatigue, legal or skill constraints modeled.
Temporary workers are assumed available after the stated operating-day delay; bookings cannot be cancelled.
No benefits, onboarding, severance, late-order penalties, packing or shipping costs.
